info.name: Recipe Manager - B1 pagination tests
info.description: Run the complete collection in order on a local disposable database. Creates three records per resource with duplicate names/titles, validates skip/limit/nextLink, follows all pages, rejects invalid queries and deletes only owned records. Existing records must not change concurrently. Uses the QA1 local environment and antiforgery cookie/token. No --bail.
